description.value: Bella Gelateria is a multiple award-winning artisan gelato shop that has claimed Best Gelato/Ice Cream in Vancouver from the Georgia Straight nearly every year since 2010, and placed in international competitions in Italy, Chicago, and Austin. The English Bay location on Davie Street sits just steps from the Stanley Park Seawall, making it a natural sweet-stop for cyclists completing the seawall loop. All gelato is made in small batches from 100% natural ingredients using Italian-imported Effi machines, with vegan sorbetto and gluten-free options available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the English Bay location of Bella Gelateria at 1752 Davie Street, Vancouver, BC V6G 1W3, matching the OSM address. Vegan and gluten-free options are confirmed by both OSM (diet:vegan=yes) and the website (sorbettos described as 'water-based and vegan friendly'; 'nut-free, gluten-free and dairy-free options' listed on the menu page). Bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are not mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content, so those remain null; takeaway is confirmed by OSM tag takeaway=yes.
concerns: OSM name 'Bella Gellataria' is a misspelling; the business's own website, branding, and URL all use 'Bella Gelateria'. The slug discovery notes also flag this discrepancy.

Front page contains anomalous text: 'pay n play casino sites Welcome to our website. We are dedicated to providing quality content and services.' This appears to be SEO spam injection or a brief site compromise; the rest of the site content is legitimate and consistent.

This is a multi-location chain (Robson St, English Bay/Davie St, Metrotown, Brentwood, Howe St); the OSM record corresponds specifically to the English Bay / Davie Street location. Other locations may exist as separate OSM nodes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Internationally award-winning gelato shop on the Davie Street corridor adjacent to the Stanley Park Seawall, a heavily cycled route; vegan and GF options confirmed. Core bike-specific amenities are unverified but the location is a clear fit for a cycling food-and-drink listing.
